## Problem and change

The develop baseline report stopped after documentation relocation because the earlier applicability review bound the previous bytes of `docs/user/COVERAGE.md`. Its three updated link destinations changed the whole-file hash.

Point CI at a new source-bound applicability assessment instead of rewriting historical hashes or bypassing validation. The main agent froze its source-based record before an independent implementation reviewer authored the second record. Both retain the same six unsupported inner-certificate attributes and the other 240 units; the protocol discloses historical-data access and makes no new blind-evaluation claim. Keep all prior assessments, evidence, task states, scorer/parser logic, hash checks and acceptance criteria unchanged. Update the operational example and test the actual workflow-selected input.

## Validation

- Implementation review and separate test review accepted the final seven-file change without findings (`/root/baseline_binding_implementation_review`, `/root/baseline_binding_test_review`).
- Python 94 tests passed (one explicit-binary control run separately); Node 38 passed.
- All 11 build/measurement/report commands from the baseline job succeeded locally, including the previously skipped later reports.
- The actual failed hosted-CI artifact reports successfully with the new assessment; the historical assessment still rejects the current document, as intended.
- Reusing that same raw CI input, all 15 metric/scope/error fields match a control using the exact historical contract and untouched old assessment. The six excluded IDs, statuses and original labels also match.
- Self-scan raw and retained result multisets remain unchanged: 3,126 raw, 1,554 exact reviewed omissions, 1,572 retained. No scan exclusions, severity changes or acceptance weakening.
- All historical files and all 62 task definitions are unchanged; no task 051 or later was started.

PR CI must pass before merge. After merging, verify both develop baseline and scan jobs, including uploaded SARIF processing and preserved audit artifacts.

https://api.github.com/repos/wakaken/pqc.body:
## Summary

Certificate key sizes previously used the encoded subjectPublicKey length (for example, reporting a 2048-bit RSA key as 2160 bits), which hid size-specific findings. Extract the actual RSA modulus length and supported EC named-curve size, separate signature and subject-key facts, and expose parsing completeness through the existing diagnostic model.

- Reuse the existing x509-parser/pem libraries, with owned public certificate/SPKI attribute helpers and SHA-256 fingerprints. Keep unknown/PQC semantic sizes unknown; record encoded sizes separately.
- Select PEM/DER by parsing content, preserve valid neighbors and actual positions in PEM bundles, and distinguish malformed or unsupported input from completed inspection. Validate expected ASN.1 container fields so the pinned parser cannot silently discard inner remainders or shorten SPKI fingerprint input.
- Extend existing file-wide snippet masking to EC/DSA/encrypted private PEM markers after reproducing synthetic payload disclosure through certificate-container findings.
- Preserve CLI production behavior, rule definitions, core finding-ID/dedup algorithms and report structures/schema versions. Corrected certificate facts and positions intentionally change affected findings/IDs. This is task 020 only: one commit, 25 files including nine public-only DER fixtures.

## Validation

Executed locally with pinned Rust 1.93.1:

- `cargo build --workspace --offline`
- `cargo fmt --all --check`
- `cargo test --workspace --offline`: 125 passed, 0 failed (105 baseline plus 20 new attribute/format/identity/privacy tests).
- `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --offline -- -D warnings`
- `node --test shell/compact-report.test.cjs`: 3 passed, 0 failed.
- `git diff --check`

English and Japanese example scans retain 290 findings, 55 selected files and 2 skipped files. All six legacy artifacts match the saved develop baseline except generation timestamps; machine outputs match across languages. The diagnostic schema-1 field sets remain unchanged.

Nine public certificate fixtures were checked against independently extracted OpenSSL facts and certificate/SPKI hashes. An actual CLI corpus with a test-only Ed25519 OID rule changes from 12 to 16 findings: exactly four correct RSA-size findings added, no rule/file pairs removed. Synthetic EC/DSA/encrypted/PKCS#8/OpenSSH payloads are absent from all seven artifacts and stdout/stderr, including mixed bundles. Strict completeness mode writes reports and returns 3.

Independent specification review passed before implementation. Full review found ignored inner ASN.1 fields and a DER-embedded PEM marker format error; regression tests failed before the fixes, then passed. Re-review approved both fixes and independently reran all 20 new tests successfully. Committed code and fixture hashes match the tested inputs. Durable evidence is in `tasks/020-certificate-attribute-parsing.yaml`, `docs/roadmap/TASK-020-IMPLEMENTATION.md` and the fixture manifest/README. Raw logs and generated comparison reports remain local under ignored `target/task020/`.

## Remaining scope

Task 021 retains filename-based classification, ECDSA/DSA rule confusion and validity-policy changes. Signature/chain/mathematical key validation, PKCS#12 decryption, standalone public-key file detection and DER bundle parsing are excluded. Dependency inspection remains NotReported, so default scan completeness can remain Unknown or Partial. No new browser acceptance or performance/precision/recall measurement was performed; remote CI results are separate from the local validation above.

https://api.github.com/repos/wakaken/pqc.body:
PQC移行の調査で使う暗号参照の棚卸しと英日レポートを拡張し、読み込み・検出器の失敗を「検出なし」と区別できる診断機能を追加します。既存Rustワークスペースを段階的に育てる設計と、実装単位のOSSロードマップも含めます。

## 変更内容

- **PQC棚卸し（タスク015）**：7言語のPQC API参照、対応候補の依存関係、旧方式名、明示的なTLS制限設定の検出を追加。証明書の署名OIDと公開鍵OIDを別々に扱い、移行案には実行環境・JOSE・接続相手との互換性条件を付記します。
- **英日レポート（タスク016・017）**：`--lang en|ja`、ローカルの日本語カタログ、ルール／検出箇所を段階的に開くコンパクトな表示、検索・絞り込み・ページ送りを追加。各検出箇所と適用する対応案の関連を保持します。実行時の翻訳サービスは使いません。
- **設計とロードマップ**：製品方針、OSS／Enterpriseの境界、共通モデル、将来のTLS／SSH Probe、品質ゲート、現状分析、一次資料台帳とタスク018〜039を追加。基本は1タスク1PRとし、必要な事前調査は別タスクにします。TLS／SSH ProbeやEnterprise基盤自体は実装していません。
- **検査診断（タスク018）**：既存APIを残した詳細結果API、失敗・部分成功・不明を区別する集計、`--diagnostics`による独立した`diagnostics.json`、`--require-complete`による終了コード3を追加。ほかの検出結果を保持し、診断には任意のエラー本文やソース内容を出力しません。

## 互換性と制約

- 既存CLIコマンド、既定の英語表示、既存6形式のファイル名・機械出力構造・Finding IDの計算方法を維持します。PQCルール追加による新規検出と、推奨文・人間向け表示の改善を含みます。
- 既定の終了コード0／1／2は維持し、不完全・不明な検査は標準エラーへ警告します。`--require-complete`指定時のみ完全性を確認できなければ3を返します。優先順位は実行エラー1、完全性3、検出しきい値2です。
- 既存検出器は内部の解析成功・適用可否・検出上限をまだ報告しないため、対象ファイルがある通常のスキャンは`unknown`となり、厳密モードは通常3を返します。検出器内部の完全性報告は後続タスクです。
- 現行CBOM／依存関係SBOMは独自JSON配列として維持しています。CycloneDX 1.7への標準出力は設計・計画段階です。静的なPQC参照を、実際の使用・交渉結果・製品全体の移行完了とは扱いません。

## 検証

最終コミット`6e8c0e2`の実装ファイルは、記録した検証時のSHA-256と一致します。Rust 1.93.1、Cargo offlineで以下を実施しました。

- `cargo build --workspace --offline`：成功
- `cargo fmt --all --check`：成功
- `cargo test --workspace --offline`：90件成功、失敗0件
- `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --offline -- -D warnings`：成功
- `node --test shell/compact-report.test.cjs`：3件成功、失敗0件
- `git diff --check`：成功
- **タスク018追加直前の`a485458`との比較**：英日それぞれ290件の検出、55件の走査対象、2件のスキップを保持。既存6形式は生成時刻を除き一致しました。この比較はタスク018の互換性を検証するものです。
- 読み込み失敗の注入、検出器のエラーと他の検出結果の共存、未知の完全性、壊れたignore設定と選択ゼロ件、ルート列挙失敗、診断書き込み失敗、終了コードの優先順位、合成canaryの非出力を検証しました。
- タスク018の独立ソースレビューで2点を修正し、回帰テストと修正箇所の確認後に承認済みです。記録は`tasks/018-inspection-diagnostics.yaml`にあります。

性能・Precision／Recallの新規測定、今回の変更に対するブラウザー受入試験は未実施です。GitHub Actionsの結果は、このPRに紐づくチェックで確認します。

## English

pqc-scan 0.2.0 inspects local source code, configuration, dependency declarations
and public certificates for PQC migration investigation. Static scanning is the
release scope. TLS, SSH offers and SSH KEX remain experimental and are not included
in the public binary.

### Installation

The binary archive targets macOS Apple Silicon (`aarch64-apple-darwin`) and includes
the matching rules, dependency notices and installation/probe guides. Download it
from the [v0.2.0 Release](https://github.com/wakaken/pqc-scan/releases/tag/v0.2.0).
Verify its SHA-256 and GitHub build provenance against the release source commit
before installation. See the [installation guide](https://github.com/wakaken/pqc-scan/blob/v0.2.0/docs/user/DISTRIBUTION.md).
Source installation uses the pinned Rust toolchain. Other binary platforms and
crates.io publication are outside this release.

### Changes

- Inspect full source candidates within finite hit/work budgets, retaining explicit diagnostics when inspection cannot complete.
- Improve generic syntax handling and Python/Ruby/Node cryptography references; preserve original evidence positions.
- Keep dependency declarations, resolved records and source origins separate, with bounded selected-local Maven/gemspec context.
- Parse public certificate attributes separately from trust validation; keep encrypted and unsupported inputs incomplete.
- Decode supported UTF-16/UTF-32 text strictly, exclude known non-scannable binaries before inspection, and summarize human diagnostics by count and examples.
- Provide English/Japanese HTML and Markdown, inventory capture, diagnostics, separate CycloneDX 1.7 exports and inventory comparison.

Findings are investigation candidates, not confirmed runtime vulnerabilities or a
certificate of completed PQC migration. Conditional/generated values, dynamic
execution and encrypted contents retain uncertainty. Report schema versions are
independent of the product version: inventory v1, SARIF 2.1.0 and CycloneDX 1.7.

The earlier 14-OSS study retains its exact source snapshots, ten-output reports,
remaining-input classification and independent reviews; it is not relabelled as a
fresh 0.2.0 scan. Exact-commit CI, package and clean-install checks cover the release
candidate. See [validation](https://github.com/wakaken/pqc-scan/blob/v0.2.0/docs/quality/V02-RELEASE-VALIDATION.md)
and the exact release build/CI links in the GitHub Release.

Probe bundles retain their dependency publication reviews. Maintenance is
best-effort for the latest verified 0.2.x, with no SLA or older-version backport
promise. See [security reporting](https://github.com/wakaken/pqc-scan/blob/v0.2.0/SECURITY.md).

## 日本語

pqc-scan 0.2.0は、ローカルのソースコード、設定、依存宣言、公開証明書からPQC移行の調査箇所を探します。今回のリリース対象は静的スキャンです。TLS・SSH提示方式・SSH KEXは実験的機能として維持し、公開バイナリには含めません。

### 導入方法

バイナリアーカイブの対象はmacOS Apple Silicon（`aarch64-apple-darwin`）です。対応するルール、依存パッケージの通知文、導入・probeの案内を同梱します。[v0.2.0のRelease](https://github.com/wakaken/pqc-scan/releases/tag/v0.2.0)から取得し、SHA-256とGitHubのビルド来歴を公開対象のソースコミットと照合してから導入してください。手順は[インストールガイド](https://github.com/wakaken/pqc-scan/blob/v0.2.0/docs/user/DISTRIBUTION.ja.md)を参照してください。

ソースから導入する場合は、指定したRustツールチェーンを使います。他の環境向けのバイナリ配布とcrates.io公開は今回の範囲に含めません。

### 主な変更

- 有限の検出件数・処理量制限の中で候補ソース全体を検査し、未完了の理由を診断情報に残します。
- 汎用的な構文対応とPython・Ruby・Nodeの暗号参照の検出を改善し、原文の位置情報を保持します。
- 依存宣言、ロックの記録、ソースの由来を分け、選択済みのローカルPOM・gemspecを上限付きで参照します。
- 公開証明書の属性と信頼検証を区別し、暗号化された入力や未対応形式を未完了として扱います。
- UTF-16・UTF-32を厳密に復号し、検査できない既知のバイナリを事前除外します。人向けの診断は件数とファイル例にまとめます。
- 日英のHTML・Markdown、詳しい棚卸し、診断情報、独立したCycloneDX 1.7出力、棚卸し比較を利用できます。

所見は調査候補であり、稼働中の脆弱性やPQC移行完了の認定ではありません。条件・生成値、動的実行、暗号化された内容には不確実性が残ります。出力形式の版は製品版と別で、Inventory v1、SARIF 2.1.0、CycloneDX 1.7です。

先行する14件のOSS検査は、対象ソース、10出力のレポート、残った入力の分類、独立レビューとともに記録しています。これを0.2.0で新たに再実行した結果とは扱いません。公開候補は対象コミットのCI・配布・クリーン導入で確認します。[検証記録](https://github.com/wakaken/pqc-scan/blob/v0.2.0/docs/quality/V02-RELEASE-VALIDATION.md)と、GitHub Releaseに記載する公開コミットのCI・ビルドのリンクを参照してください。

## Summary

Certificate key sizes previously used the encoded subjectPublicKey length (for example, reporting a 2048-bit RSA key as 2160 bits), which hid size-specific findings. Extract the actual RSA modulus length and supported EC named-curve size, separate signature and subject-key facts, and expose parsing completeness through the existing diagnostic model.

- Reuse the existing x509-parser/pem libraries, with owned public certificate/SPKI attribute helpers and SHA-256 fingerprints. Keep unknown/PQC semantic sizes unknown; record encoded sizes separately.
- Select PEM/DER by parsing content, preserve valid neighbors and actual positions in PEM bundles, and distinguish malformed or unsupported input from completed inspection. Validate expected ASN.1 container fields so the pinned parser cannot silently discard inner remainders or shorten SPKI fingerprint input.
- Extend existing file-wide snippet masking to EC/DSA/encrypted private PEM markers after reproducing synthetic payload disclosure through certificate-container findings.
- Preserve CLI production behavior, rule definitions, core finding-ID/dedup algorithms and report structures/schema versions. Corrected certificate facts and positions intentionally change affected findings/IDs. This is task 020 only: one commit, 25 files including nine public-only DER fixtures.

## Validation

Executed locally with pinned Rust 1.93.1:

- `cargo build --workspace --offline`
- `cargo fmt --all --check`
- `cargo test --workspace --offline`: 125 passed, 0 failed (105 baseline plus 20 new attribute/format/identity/privacy tests).
- `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --offline -- -D warnings`
- `node --test shell/compact-report.test.cjs`: 3 passed, 0 failed.
- `git diff --check`

English and Japanese example scans retain 290 findings, 55 selected files and 2 skipped files. All six legacy artifacts match the saved develop baseline except generation timestamps; machine outputs match across languages. The diagnostic schema-1 field sets remain unchanged.

Nine public certificate fixtures were checked against independently extracted OpenSSL facts and certificate/SPKI hashes. An actual CLI corpus with a test-only Ed25519 OID rule changes from 12 to 16 findings: exactly four correct RSA-size findings added, no rule/file pairs removed. Synthetic EC/DSA/encrypted/PKCS#8/OpenSSH payloads are absent from all seven artifacts and stdout/stderr, including mixed bundles. Strict completeness mode writes reports and returns 3.

Independent specification review passed before implementation. Full review found ignored inner ASN.1 fields and a DER-embedded PEM marker format error; regression tests failed before the fixes, then passed. Re-review approved both fixes and independently reran all 20 new tests successfully. Committed code and fixture hashes match the tested inputs. Durable evidence is in `tasks/020-certificate-attribute-parsing.yaml`, `docs/roadmap/TASK-020-IMPLEMENTATION.md` and the fixture manifest/README. Raw logs and generated comparison reports remain local under ignored `target/task020/`.

## Remaining scope

Task 021 retains filename-based classification, ECDSA/DSA rule confusion and validity-policy changes. Signature/chain/mathematical key validation, PKCS#12 decryption, standalone public-key file detection and DER bundle parsing are excluded. Dependency inspection remains NotReported, so default scan completeness can remain Unknown or Partial. No new browser acceptance or performance/precision/recall measurement was performed; remote CI results are separate from the local validation above.
